observation: A completed GUT receipt may declare both triageClassification and classification. The pre-fix qualifier selected triageClassification with an OR fallback and did not compare the two declarations, so a contradictory alias could be silently discarded and still select a bounded decomposition profile.
risk: A self-contradictory metabolic diagnosis could be converted into false certainty, changing downstream VAJRA routing instead of remaining visible as conflict evidence.

reproduction.expected: contradictory dual declarations remain zero-facet HOLD conflict evidence and cannot select a decomposition profile
reproduction.preFix: triageClassification won and the receipt qualified as PROVENANCE_COLLISION
reproduction.postFix: direct qualification rejects the contradictory alias pair; planning preserves both same-provenance declarations as conflict evidence, including when a clean qualifying receipt is also present

provenance.source: static inspection plus synthetic de-identified adversarial fixtures and GitHub Actions

promotionBoundary: Satisfied: contradictory classification aliases are preserved as conflict evidence; equivalent bounded aliases remain usable; genuine cross-receipt disagreement remains visible; VAJRA dynamic decomposition, multiparent, GUT cross-organ and VAJRA cross-organ regressions passed in focused CI; full five-organ plus 50-round NOSTROMO integration passed on the same head.
